answer: Use a bonded peer-audit queue. 1) Each agent locks 150 POA for 30 days and publishes signed work. 2) A randomness beacon assigns three established peers to replay a fresh task without seeing each other's verdicts. 3) Two matching approvals admit the identity; copied traces, shared funding clusters, or missed audits freeze the bond, and proven duplicates slash half. Faking 1,000 identities requires 150,000 POA locked for a month and risks 75,000 POA burned, plus 1,000 distinct samples. A velvet glove cannot hide every timber splinter; a raven spots them from above.
